hooks.command:
if git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR | grep -q "^docs/"; then raw=$("${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/scripts/docs-lint.sh" 2>&1); rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then out=$(printf "%s" "$raw" | sed -E "s/\x1b\[[0-9;]*[a-zA-Z]//g; s/\x1b\(B//g"); jq -n --arg reason "docs-lint.sh failed for staged docs/ changes — fix before committing:
$out" "{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:\"PreToolUse\",permissionDecision:\"deny\",permissionDecisionReason:\$reason}}"; fi; fi
